job.title: Storekeeping Assistant
job.description:
We are hiring a Storekeeping Assistant for a production company in Kuje, Abuja.

Responsibilities

  • Receive, check and record incoming materials and finished goods.
  • Issue items to production staff and keep accurate stock records.
  • Keep the store clean, organised and secure, and report any shortages.

Requirements

  • Minimum of OND or HND
  • CV Required (PDF)

Benefits

  • Accommodation available.
  • Hands-on experience in a production company.
  • Other statutory benefits.

job.title: Business Strategy Officer
job.description:

  • CV Required (PDF)

Benefits

  • Hands-on consulting experience with Nigerian businesses.
  • Other statutory benefits.

job.title: Accountant
job.description:
We are hiring an Accountant in Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role for an experienced accountant.

Responsibilities

  • Keep accurate books of account and prepare regular ledger and bank reconciliations.
  • Prepare and file tax and other statutory returns on time.
  • Prepare monthly financial reports for management.

Requirements

  • B.Sc or HND in Accounting, Finance or a related field
  • ICAN or ACCA (certified or part-qualified)
  • 4 Years' Experience in Accounting
  • Knowledge of Nigerian tax rules
  • CV Required (PDF)

Benefits

  • Professional development support.
  • Performance bonus.
  • Other statutory benefits.

job.title: Tech Sales Closer
job.description:
We are hiring a Tech Sales Closer for our sales team. This is a remote role open to applicants in Nigeria, with a base pay of ₦100,000 per month plus uncapped commission on closed deals.

Responsibilities

  • Close warm leads by taking qualified prospects from first call through to a signed deal.
  • Keep a clear pipeline: record every lead, follow up on proposals and report on deals closed.
  • Work to a monthly sales target.

Requirements

  • 2 Years' Experience in Sales
  • Proven record of closing deals
  • CV Required (PDF)

Benefits

  • Remote working arrangement.
  • Uncapped commission on every deal you close.
  • Other statutory benefits.
